MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
WITH i, sum(t.seconds) AS v, collect(t.historyId) AS tes
ORDER BY v DESC
WITH collect({i:i,v:v,tes:tes}) AS all
WITH all, all[4].v AS cut
UNWIND all AS r
WITH r WHERE r.v>=cut
MATCH (r.i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
RETURN r.i.issueKey AS id, r.v AS value, pr.projectKey AS project, r.tes AS tes

MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
WITH i, sum(t.seconds) AS v, collect(t.historyId) AS tes
ORDER BY v DESC
WITH collect({i:i,v:v,tes:tes}) AS all
WITH all, all[4].v AS cut
UNWIND all AS r
WITH r WHERE r.v>=cut
WITH r.i AS i, r.v AS v, r.tes AS tes
MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
RETURN i.issueKey AS id, v AS value, pr.projectKey AS project, tes

MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
RETURN i.issueKey AS id, sum(t.seconds) AS value, collect(t.historyId) AS tes ORDER BY value DESC

MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project) WHERE t.seconds>0 AND t.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.loggedAt<datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND (i.resolutionName IS NULL OR i.resolutionName='')
WITH i, pr, collect(t.historyId) AS tes, sum(t.seconds) AS v
UNWIND tes AS te
RETURN i.issueKey AS id, v AS value, pr.projectKey AS project, te ORDER BY v DESC
